question: Can locally matched film-reference color distributions support visibly rich, comfortable source-adaptive appearance beyond the same global operator and a global operator with the same support mask?
claim_ceiling: Single development-only reference-informed local appearance pilot; automatic per-input coefficient fitting, not an amortized generalizer, calibrated film response, independent validation or a guarantee of preserved factual content.
amendment: Before any new outcome, replace Pro's hue/median-preserving enhancement with full cross-channel log-odds photometry and local projected RGB quantiles. Remove source-reference brightness and hue compatibility vetoes. Reference mismatch is an empirical risk. Retain reciprocal distinct-reference support and explicit controls. Use the pinned VGG's embedded preprocessing, never ImageNet normalization. V2 changes only the admission threshold calibration: reference-only leave-one-file-out third-order reciprocal distances, uncapped Q90. Original V1 and its no-support outcome remain unchanged. This is not a visual strength/loss/reference rescue. Cached descriptors are consumed without extraction.
roles: All four source images and all 19 Italy references already consumed development-only. No held-set access. Italy is one author/travel/scan group, not 19 independent film-response samples.
stopping_rule: Exactly one reference-calibrated V2 batch: four sources x four arms, unchanged 384 updates per supported fit and 45-minute/8-GiB caps. No further threshold/strength/loss/reference changes. Empty support explicitly remains identity. Original V1 stays a no-support result.
decision_rule: Engineering checks are not photographic success. Retain only if L visibly changes all four images into comfortable rich appearances without consequential loss of visible objects, faces or text; L must beat G and GM on at least three of four with no consequential regression on the fourth and beat M on at least three of four. Numerical mechanism probes alone never promote. Reject/no-support outcomes close this exact pilot without tuning matches, references, strength or budgets. Independent visual judgment remains pending until actual outputs are inspected.
operator: At each pixel y=x*exp(delta)/(1-x+x*exp(delta)), delta=b+A(2*x-1). Nodes have abs(b)<=2 and each A row L1<=1; positive partition-of-unity cubic B-spline interpolation and scalar support preserve these bounds. Original zero/one endpoints are exact. For a FROZEN field, the residual logit Jacobian infinity norm is <=0.5; input-dependent retrieval/field construction and spatial derivatives are outside this statement.
control_definition: L uses local 12-coefficient nodes with support. G uses one global 12-coefficient vector without support. GM uses the same global vector with identical support. M uses local nodes/support but cyclically permutes complete target bundles among supported source centers using the nonzero cyclic shift with maximum summed squared center distance; confidence and source descriptors stay fixed. If fewer than two supported centers, M is explicitly non-discriminating.
